validated_on: Abaqus/CAE 2026 (Python kernel), Windows, live file-IPC bridge v4.0.0
bridge: agent -> client.send -> mcp_home file IPC -> abaqus_mcp_plugin.mcp_loop -> mdb/session

A_material_plasticity.model: 10x10x10 mm cube, C3D8R enhanced hourglass, E=210000 MPa, nu=0.3, EPP yield=250 MPa

checks.note: Mises pinned exactly at yield = plastic plateau reached; PEEQ output reads fine.

The 10% gap vs sigma_y*initial_area(25000) is the EXPECTED nlgeom large-deformation effect: at 5% true compression current area grows ~5% (plastic incompressibility), so true-stress force ~27.7 kN. FE 27.56 kN matches within 0.5%. RF balance confirmed.

C_contact.model: deformable cube 10mm on discrete rigid flat platen, frictionless SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd, main/secondary (Abaqus 2026 rename), finite sliding, nlgeom=ON, driven u3=-0.2 mm

checks.note: CPRESS/COPEN are emitted as per-interaction fields 'CPRESS   ASSEMBLY_<slave>/<master>', NOT under 'CSTRESS'. Top reaction ~413 kN matches elastic E*strain*A=420 kN.

D_diagnosis.deliberate_fault: free cube, concentrated load, NO boundary condition

checks.sta_evidence: exponential incremental cutback: time 1.0 -> 0.25 -> 0.0625 -> 0.0156 -> 0.0039, 'U' iteration flags, 'THE ANALYSIS HAS NOT BEEN COMPLETED'
checks.msg_evidence: ***WARNING: SOLVER PROBLEM. NUMERICAL SINGULARITY WHEN PROCESSING NODE B-1.x (repeated at free nodes)
checks.agent_diagnosis: rigid-body motion / under-constraint -> add BCs; do NOT simply reduce increment.
also_diagnosed_live: discrete rigid part not meshed -> .dat 'ELEMENT SET ..._BODY HAS NOT BEEN DEFINED' + 'MAIN SURFACE ... DOES NOT EXIST' -> fix: mesh the rigid part
SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd master=/slave= rejected in 2026 -> use main=/secondary= (version-dependent upstream API)

version_dependent_findings_for_reference: SurfaceToSurfaceContactStd: use main=/secondary= (NOT master=/slave=) in Abaqus 2026.
Contact pressure output is per-interaction key 'CPRESS   <slave>/<master>'; 'CSTRESS' is not a field key.
Discrete rigid parts MUST be meshed (R3D4) before RigidBody bodyRegion / contact surface resolve to an element set.
Part.translate does not exist in 2026 CAE Python; position geometry at build time or use datum planes.
import mesh is required in kernel scripts (from abaqus import * does not bind 'mesh').
kernel scripts must be UTF-8 WITHOUT BOM (U+FEFF breaks exec).
